readings: Considering only invoices that have at least one Invoice_Line_Items row with a non-missing product_price, compute each such invoice's mean product_price and its count of line-item rows. Return one row with the average of those per-invoice means and the average of those per-invoice line-item counts, unrounded.

Compute the average, across invoices having at least one non-missing product_price, of each invoice's mean non-missing product_price. Separately compute the average number of Invoice_Line_Items rows per invoice across all invoices that have at least one line-item row, including invoices whose prices are all missing. Return one row with these two values, unrounded.

Compute the average, across invoices having at least one non-missing product_price, of each invoice's mean non-missing product_price. Separately compute the average number of Invoice_Line_Items rows per invoice across all invoices in the Invoices table, counting invoices with no line items as 0. Return one row with these two values, unrounded.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_price), AVG(cnt)
FROM (
  SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
  HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0
);

SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS avg_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0)) AS avg_of_invoice_avg_price,
  (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number)) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice

SELECT
(SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS avg_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE product_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number)) AS avg_of_invoice_avg_price,
(SELECT CAST(COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_number) FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice
